title: Reliable and Sensitive Detection of Carbonylated Proteins by Oxime Blot
author: Filip Luka Mikulić

steps.title: Prepare cell culture medium
steps.instruction: Combine DMEM (440 mL), 10 % FBS (56.8 mL), 1 % L‑glutamine (5 mL), and 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin (5 mL) to a final volume of 500 mL; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Make 0.1 M phosphate buffer pH 7.4
steps.instruction: Dissolve 27.598 g NaH₂PO₄·H₂O and 53.614 g Na₂HPO₄·7H₂O in deionized water; adjust pH to 7.4 with 5 M HCl or 5 M NaOH; bring volume to 500 mL.

steps.title: Make 5 M NaCl solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 146.1 g NaCl in deionized water and bring volume to 500 mL; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare RIPA phosphate lysis buffer with inhibitors
steps.instruction: For each mL of lysis buffer base add: 5 µL 1 mg/mL aprotinin, 5 µL 10 mg/mL leupeptin, 5 µL 0.2 M NaF, 5 µL 0.2 M Na₃VO₄, 15 µL 0.1 M PMSF, 40 µL 2 M β‑glycerophosphate; base (50 mL) contains 5 mL 0.1 M phosphate buffer (10 mM), 1.5 mL 5 M NaCl (150 mM), 0.714 g NP‑40 (1 %), 38.575 mg DTT (5 mM), 50 mg sodium deoxycholate (0.1 %); bring to 50 mL with water, keep at 4 °C. Alternatively dissolve one Complete Mini tablet in 10 mL base, aliquot, store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 200 mM DTT solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 15.43 mg DTT in deionized water; adjust volume to 500 µL; prepare fresh before use.

steps.title: Prepare 500 mM pPDA with 5 mM DTT
steps.instruction: Weigh 55.17 mg p‑phenylenediamine (pPDA) into a 1.5 mL tube, add 353.45 µL DMSO, vortex to dissolve; for each 97.5 µL of this solution add 2.5 µL freshly prepared 200 mM DTT to obtain 500 mM pPDA with 5 mM DTT.

steps.title: Prepare 100 mM biotin‑aminooxy solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 50.0 mg EZ‑Link Alkoxyamine‑PEG4‑Biotin in 1,151 µL DMSO; aliquot for single experiments, store at –80 °C; avoid freeze‑thaw cycles; stable ≥1 year.

steps.title: Make 4× SDS‑PAGE loading buffer (reducing)
steps.instruction: Combine 5 mL 0.5 M Tris‑HCl pH 6.8, 4 mL 40 % glycerol, 0.8 g SDS (8 % w/v), 0.4 mL 2‑mercaptoethanol (4 % v/v), 4 mg bromophenol blue (0.01 %); bring volume to 10 mL with water; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 10 % APS solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 100 mg ammonium persulfate in deionized water and bring volume to 1 mL; prepare fresh for each gel.

steps.title: Prepare 10 % SDS solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10.0 g SDS in deionized water and bring volume to 100 mL; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Make resolving gel buffer (1.5 M Tris‑HCl pH 8.8)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 181.7 g Tris base in water, adjust pH to 8.8 with 37 % HCl, bring volume to 800 mL; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Make stacking gel buffer (0.5 M Tris‑HCl pH 6.8)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 60.6 g Tris base in water, adjust pH to 6.8 with 37 % HCl, bring volume to 800 mL; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 10× SDS‑PAGE running buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 30.29 g Tris base and 144.13 g glycine in 900 mL water, add 10 mL 10 % SDS; bring to 1 L; store at room temperature (pH ≈8.3).

steps.title: Prepare 1× SDS‑PAGE running buffer
steps.instruction: Dilute 100 mL 10× running buffer with 900 mL water (or use 10 mL 10% SDS); keep at room temperature (or 4 °C if infrequently used).

steps.title: Prepare western transfer buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 3.03 g Tris base and 14.4 g glycine in water, add 200 mL methanol (20 %); bring volume to 1 L; prepare on transfer day, keep on ice (‑20 °C) during electrophoresis.

steps.title: Prepare Ponceau S staining solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.05 g Ponceau S and 2.5 mL 5 % glacial acetic acid in water; bring volume to 50 mL, wrap in foil, store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 10× TBS‑T
steps.instruction: Dissolve 6.05 g Tris base and 8.76 g NaCl in water, adjust pH to 7.5 with 37 % HCl, bring volume to 800 mL, add 1 mL Tween‑20, bring to 1 L; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare blocking solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2.5 g non‑fat dry milk in 5 mL 1× TBS‑T; bring volume to 50 mL with water; prepare on day of transfer, keep at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Streptavidin‑HRP solution (1:1000)
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µL Streptavidin‑HRP (1 ‰) with 1 mL 1× TBS‑T and 10 mL water; bring volume to 10 mL, mix well; prepare just before membrane incubation.

steps.title: Prepare ECL detection solution
steps.instruction: Mix 2 mL Pierce ECL Solution A with 2 mL Solution B (50 % each); for a 9 × 7 cm membrane use 4 mL total; mix immediately before use.

steps.title: Make resolving gel solutions
steps.instruction: For each desired acrylamide % (7‑12 %): combine appropriate volumes of Milli‑Q water, 30 % acrylamide/bis, resolving gel buffer, and 10 % SDS to total 10 mL (e.g., 7 %: 5.1 mL water, 2.3 mL acrylamide, 2.5 mL buffer, 100 µL 10 % SDS). Add 50 µL 10 % APS and 5 µL TEMED; mix gently and pour into casting plates.

steps.title: Make 4 % stacking gel solution
steps.instruction: Combine 6.1 mL water, 1.3 mL 30 % acrylamide/bis, 2.5 mL stacking gel buffer, 100 µL 10 % SDS to 10 mL; add 50 µL 10 % APS and 5 µL TEMED; mix gently and pour on top of polymerized resolving gel.

steps.title: Culture A549 cells
steps.instruction: Seed A549 cells in T75 flasks with cell culture medium; incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, humidified atmosphere until ~80 % confluence.

steps.title: Harvest and lyse cells
steps.instruction: Remove medium, rinse flask with 10 mL ice‑cold PBS, discard. Add 1.5 mL Trypsin‑EDTA, incubate 37 °C 5 min. Swirl, tap to detach. Add 9 mL medium to neutralize, collect cells. Centrifuge 300 × g 10 min 4 °C. Wash pellet 2× with PBS. Add 0.1 mL lysis buffer per 10⁷ cells, incubate on ice 30 min, vortex 30 s every 10 min. Centrifuge lysate 15,000 × g 15 min 4 °C. Transfer supernatant to new tube.

steps.title: Quantify and adjust protein concentration
steps.instruction: Measure protein concentration (e.g., OD280 on BioDrop μLite+ or BCA assay). Dilute or concentrate lysate with RIPA phosphate lysis buffer (with inhibitors) to achieve ~5 mg/mL.

steps.title: Label carbonyl groups (oxime reaction)
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL (or 2 mL) tube combine: 80 µL cell lysate, 10 µL 100 mM biotin‑aminooxy, 10 µL 500 mM pPDA/5 mM DTT. Prepare a negative control with 80 µL lysate + 20 µL lysis buffer (no reagents). Incubate at 25 °C, 500 rpm for 3 h in a thermomixer.

steps.title: Add loading buffer and denature
steps.instruction: Add 33.3 µL 4× loading buffer to each labeling reaction; heat at 95 °C for 5 min. Use immediately or store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Cast and polymerize SDS‑PAGE gels
steps.instruction: Assemble glass plates, check for leaks with water, dry. Pour resolving gel (≈5.5 mL for 1.5 mm thickness), overlay with 1 mL isopropanol, allow polymerization. Decant isopropanol, rinse with water, dry. Pour 4 % stacking gel, insert comb at angle, polymerize ~30 min. Store gels moist at 4 °C if needed.

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Prepare 1× SDS‑PAGE running buffer. Remove comb, wash wells 2–3× with buffer. Assemble cassette, fill with buffer, ensure no leaks. Load prestained marker (3–4 µL) and samples (10–30 µL). Fill lower chamber so gel bottom is ~1 cm immersed. Run at 100 V until samples enter resolving gel, then increase to 150 V until dye front reaches gel bottom. Disassemble cassette, remove gel.

steps.title: Stain gel with Coomassie (optional)
steps.instruction: Invert InstantBlue Coomassie bottle, add ~20 mL stain to gel, incubate 30–60 min at room temperature with gentle shaking. Briefly rinse with water, image gel (e.g., ChemiDoc MP).

steps.title: Activate PVDF membrane
steps.instruction: Soak PVDF membrane in 100 % methanol for 1 min, rinse with water 2–3 min, then incubate in transfer buffer until use.

steps.title: Assemble transfer sandwich
steps.instruction: Soak sponge pads in cold transfer buffer. Stack (cathode to anode): sponge pad, filter paper, gel, PVDF membrane, filter paper, sponge pad. Remove bubbles with a rounded pipette tip.

steps.title: Transfer proteins to membrane
steps.instruction: Place sandwich in electrode module (cathode side black). Fill transfer tank with cold transfer buffer just below top of module. Keep tank in ice‑filled Styrofoam box, add ice as needed. Run at 400 mA for 2 h (for two gels).

steps.title: Stain membrane with Ponceau S
steps.instruction: Incubate membrane in Ponceau S solution with gentle shaking for 5–15 min until proteins visible. Decant stain (reusable). Rinse 2–3× with water, then destain by shaking in water 5 min at 30 rpm. Image if desired.

steps.title: Block membrane
steps.instruction: Incubate membrane in blocking solution (5 % non‑fat dry milk in 1× TBS‑T) for 1 h at room temperature with gentle shaking (30 rpm). Optional: block overnight. Wash membrane twice with 1× TBS‑T, 5 min each.

steps.title: Incubate with Streptavidin‑HRP
steps.instruction: Prepare 1:1,000 Streptavidin‑HRP solution (10 µL HRP + 1 mL 1× TBS‑T + 10 mL water). Incubate membrane 1 h at room temperature with gentle shaking (30 rpm).

steps.title: Wash membrane post‑HRP
steps.instruction: Wash membrane 3 × with 15–20 mL 1× TBS‑T, 5–10 min each wash, with gentle shaking.

steps.title: Detect signal with ECL
steps.instruction: Prepare 4 mL ECL detection solution (mix equal parts Solution A and B). Apply to membrane, immediately capture chemiluminescent image on imaging system.
